thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Service error rate spike on model v5-quant · region=us-west · 5m error rate=8.2% · latency p95 up 2x. Auto-escalation to on-call. :rotating_light:

devon: taking pager. seeing lots of 503s and token decode errors from the quantized variant. can someone check node health and redis KV cache?

sara: on it, checking node metrics now. pinging the infra runbook for quick mitigations. first priority: reduce customer-visible errors.

raj: if v5-stable is healthy we can steer traffic to it. quant variant likely regressed after a kernel change last night.

devon: agreed. plan: 1) soft-throttle heavy API keys 2) route new traffic off v5-quant in us-west to v5-stable 3) keep canaries in eu to monitor. anyone object?

emily: no objections. adding customer impact: a few enterprise customers on bursty keys report timeouts. throttling will queue requests but avoid hard failures.

devon: executing mitigation — reducing variant weight. command:```bash
rictl routing update --model v5 --region us-west --variant v5-quant --weight 0 --variant-fallback v5-stable
```

devon: running now. response: "ok: routing update accepted, rollout id=rt-20240401-42" :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rollout rt-20240401-42 started. Phased cutover: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 2m, with health checks.

sara: starting key-level soft throttles for top offenders. command:```bash
rictl key throttle --key client-prod-47 --rate 15r/s --burst 30
rictl key throttle --key client-prod-88 --rate 10r/s --burst 20
```

raj: note — adding a short-lived emergency quota cap across the org to limit p95 spikes. doing a global enforcement for 10 minutes.

devon: traffic shift just hit 50% and error rate trending down to 2.1%. latency p95 still elevated but improving.

emily: calling out customer support: please prepare message template for affected customers explaining temporary throttling + failover to stable variant. cc @customer-success.

devon: also observed higher memory growth on a subset of v5-quant hosts. opened infra ticket: infra-5123. will collect perf dumps for the runtime team.

sara: handing off from pager to devon-2 for the 23:00 -> 07:00 shift. devon-2 (alias raj) — you're up if anything regresses. I'll stay available for escalation. :wave:

raj: taking handoff. summary: v5-quant disabled in us-west (weight=0), emergency throttles on high-volume keys, rollout id rt-20240401-42 in progress, infra ticket infra-5123 for memory growth. Current customer impact: degraded latency for some customers, errors down from 8% -> 1.8%.

devon: quick rollback note for audit: command used to restore previous routing if needed:```bash
rictl routing rollback --rollout rt-20240401-42 --force
```

deploy-bot: Rollout rt-20240401-42 reached 100% in us-west and passed health checks.

sara: monitoring for 30m. if stable, we'll keep v5-quant shelved and schedule a canary redeploy after runtime fixes. tagging research/infra to triage kernel change.

emily: sent customer notification draft to #customer-success-drafts for review.

devon: closing real-time mitigation. follow-ups: 1) postmortem with timeline + root cause 2) verify no regressions in eu canaries 3) run regression evals on quant builds.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 — monitoring. Incident incident-20240401-7 created for follow-ups.

raj: adding links to artifacts: perf dumps -> https://artifacts.internal/reports/infra-5123, rollout -> https://console/redwood/rollouts/rt-20240401-42

sara: thanks team. if anything pops later ping me or reopen the thread. :thumbsup:
